verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents OpenTelemetry-based ingestion for traces, logs, and metrics — including logs from files/stdout/FluentBit/cloud services and metrics from 'applications, infrastructure, and existing Prometheus setups' — and can be deployed via Docker/Kubernetes/Linux, but the evidence is thin on named vendor-maintained agents for specific cloud services or container/K8s workload instrumentation beyond generic OTel Collector mentions. A community report explicitly flags a documentation gap for basic host-level (CPU/Memory/Disk) metrics, directly undercutting the 'instrument hosts' part of the story. Missing for 10: dedicated docs/integrations pages for AWS/GCP/Azure service agents, container-runtime specific agents, and confirmation that host-level metrics are a first-class supported integration rather than a documented gap.
